build_lru_cache: build an LRU cache with a given capacity and optional getsizeof callback for size-aware eviction
pin_cache_key: pin a key in the LRU cache to prevent it from being evicted during LRU ordering
get_cache_stats: get cumulative or delta hit and total query statistics from the LRU cache
remove_oldest_cache_item: remove the oldest unpinned item from the LRU cache or force-remove pinned items
test_cache_usage: test the LRU cache hit ratio and current usage percentage relative to capacity
